summary: Read a singly linked list. Relink the nodes into this order: the head, the tail, the second node, the node second from the tail, the third node, the node third from the tail, and so on until every node appears once. Do not rewrite the integer stored inside a node. Change only successor pointers. Write the list after that relinking. When the list has no node or only one node, leave it unchanged.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a node count followed by the integer stored in each node.
